deltas.before: Enrolled act created a qualified data center sales tax exemption for construction, equipment, eligible costs and certain labor, subject to a $250 million investment commitment, jobs and other conditions; eligible costs exclude electricity. It also limits a specified economic-development electric-rate discount and requires fusion-center review and approval before public financial assistance or benefits.
deltas.after: Enrolled act created a qualified data center sales tax exemption for construction, equipment, eligible costs and certain labor, subject to a $250 million investment commitment, jobs and other conditions; eligible costs exclude electricity. It also limits a specified economic-development electric-rate discount and requires fusion-center review and approval before public financial assistance or benefits. K.S.A. 74-50,333(a) and Revenue Notice 25-03 apply the exemption to qualified purchases made on or after July 1, 2025; approval still requires Commerce certification.

deltas.before: House adopted 93-0 on 2025-06-08; Senate received it that day and returned it to the calendar subject to call on 2025-06-09. The baseline reports that it died at adjournment; final disposition remains unverified.
deltas.after: The retained named history records House adoption 93-0 on June 8, 2025, and a last recorded Senate action on June 9: return to the calendar subject to call. Searches of extracted June 10–12 Senate journal text, including the final-day post-session appendix, identified no HCR 61 action. The Senate adjourned sine die on June 12 at 5:52 p.m. Historical regular-session nonpassage is a bounded inference from these records, not a bill-specific Died event.

deltas.before: Clarified administration of data center sales and use tax exemptions, including treatment of existing employment positions for qualifying refurbishment or newly eligible facilities.
deltas.after: Clarified administration of data center sales and use tax exemptions, including treatment of existing employment positions for qualifying refurbishment or newly eligible facilities. Later 2026 chapter 266, section 2 amended RCW 82.08.986: the rural refurbishment-based exemption expires July 1, 2026, and new refurbishment certificates may not be issued on or after that date.

deltas.before: Expands Clean Energy Transformation Act coverage to certain port districts, single-customer consumer-owned utilities, and affected market customers; committee reports describe the bill as closing data center clean-power compliance gaps.
deltas.after: Expands Clean Energy Transformation Act coverage to certain port districts, single-customer consumer-owned utilities, and affected market customers; committee reports describe the bill as closing data center clean-power compliance gaps. The codified consumer-owned utility definition excludes a public utility district formed under Title 54 RCW with only one retail electric customer in Washington, provided that customer remains the same as of January 1, 2026 and the district continues receiving 100 percent of its electricity needs from Bonneville Power Administration.

deltas.before: Expires or narrows certain data center sales and use tax exemption certificates, including certificates for qualifying refurbished data centers; bill reports document industry opposition and state revenue/ratepayer arguments.
deltas.after: Expires or narrows certain data center sales and use tax exemption certificates, including certificates for qualifying refurbished data centers; bill reports document industry opposition and state revenue/ratepayer arguments. Revenue’s June 3 rural and July 16 urban notices describe July 1, 2026 changes to refurbishment eligibility and exclusion of replacement server equipment; the rural notice expressly bars new refurbishment certificates on or after July 1.

deltas.before: R confirmed for Steinmetz, French, Allemand, Bear, Kevin Campbell, Heiner, Neiman and Webber in the official 2026 rosters. [VERIFY: the bill lists Senator Pearson, but identity and party are not established by the captured Senate roster.]
deltas.after: R confirmed for Steinmetz, French, Allemand, Bear, Kevin Campbell, Heiner, Neiman and Webber in the official 2026 rosters. Senator Pearson is identified as Laura Taliaferro Pearson, Republican, Senate District 14: the official 2026 profile uses Laura Taliaferro, while official state election and legislative publications supply the full name.
